# Twin Cities live music calendar

> Weekly-updated list of live music in the seven-county Twin Cities metro: 817 shows at 69 venues, 2026-11-14 to 2027-02-05. Machine-readable copies of https://music.tcshows.org/ . Listings are collected from venue calendars and public listings each week and may be incomplete or out of date; check the venue before you go.

## Show lists

- [All shows (Markdown)](https://music.tcshows.org/shows.md): every show, grouped by day
- [All shows (JSON)](https://music.tcshows.org/shows.json): same data as one JSON document
- [One day, Markdown](https://music.tcshows.org/shows/2026-11-14.md): replace the date with any day in the window; `.json` works too
- [Venue list (JSON)](https://music.tcshows.org/venues.json): venue slugs and show counts
- [One venue, Markdown](https://music.tcshows.org/venues/10k-brewing.md): replace the slug with one from venues.json; `.json` works too

## Fields

Each show has id, headliner, openers, date (YYYY-MM-DD, local), start_time (HH:MM 24-hour or null), venue, city, genre. Optional: doors_time, end_date, status (sold_out, canceled, postponed), hidden_category (dj_night, residency), recurrence, price (the source's wording), is_free, age (all_ages, 18+, 21+), tickets, source, spotify. A missing optional field means unknown, not no.

## Optional

- [Interactive page](https://music.tcshows.org/): the same shows with filters
